create.name: Yasmin Boland
create.bio:
Yasmin Boland is an astrologer and author who worked as a journalist and television producer before turning to astrology. In the late 1990s she began learning about lunar practice from women she met, from Moon circles and from her reading, and she came to centre her work on two simple rhythms: setting intentions at the New Moon and letting go at the Full Moon. She says these practices draw mostly on Celtic and Hindu sources, and since 2004 she has made regular visits to an ashram in southern India devoted to the goddesses Lakshmi, Saraswati and Durga.

Her approach, which she calls Moonology, treats the Moon's phases and eclipses as a practical calendar for reflection and manifesting, and she writes with women especially in mind. Her books include Moonology, Astrology Made Easy and The Mercury Retrograde Book, and she created the Moonology oracle cards. She publishes free daily, weekly and monthly horoscopes, hosts the weekly Mainly Moonology podcast, which mixes the week's astrology with listener chart readings, and shares chants and short meditations for different points in the lunar and planetary cycle.

books.title: Moonology: Working with the Magic of Lunar Cycles
books.author: Yasmin Boland
books.description: Her guide to following the Moon's phases, signs and eclipses as a framework for setting intentions and letting go. It explains New Moon wishing and Full Moon release step by step.

books.title: Moonology Oracle Cards
books.author: Yasmin Boland
books.description: A deck of oracle cards built around the Moon's phases and signs, with a guidebook. It is meant for reflection and for planning around the lunar cycle.

books.title: Astrology Made Easy
books.author: Yasmin Boland
books.description: A beginner's handbook to reading a birth chart, covering signs, planets, houses and aspects. Aimed at readers who want to interpret their own chart.

books.title: The Mercury Retrograde Book
books.author: Yasmin Boland
books.description: A short book on working with Mercury's retrograde periods instead of dreading them. It suggests ways to use these weeks to open up new opportunities.

books.title: Angel Astrology 101
books.author: Doreen Virtue and Yasmin Boland
books.description: Co-written with Doreen Virtue, it links the signs and planets of a birth chart with the angels traditionally associated with them. A light introduction for readers drawn to both astrology and angels.

free_resources.title: Mainly Moonology Podcast
free_resources.description: Her free weekly show on the astrology of the week ahead, with listeners calling in for chart readings and guests from the astrology world.

free_resources.title: Your Saraswati meditation for Mercury retrograde
free_resources.description: A free recorded meditation devoted to the goddess Saraswati, whom she pairs with Mercury as a patron of language and learning. Offered for use during any Mercury retrograde.
